title: Load sharing at lumbar motion segments - Adams M, Hutton W, Stott J 1980 (The resistance to flexion of the lumbar intervertebral joint) (secondary, Ghezelbash 2020 review)

quantity.name: load sharing
quantity.definition: share (%) of the resisting flexion moment by disc vs ligaments (sum of capsular, flavum and supra/interspinous) from successive resection; mean +/- SD for disc

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Schmidt H, Shirazi-Adl A, El-Rich M
source.sample: not stated in review (see primary: Adams M, Hutton W, Stott J 1980 (The resistance to flexion of the lumbar intervertebral joint)); human cadaveric lumbar specimens of Adams M, Hutton W, Stott J 1980 (The resistance to flexion of the lumbar intervertebral joint), as compiled in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 Table 1

protocol.summary: Flexion to full / half of the elastic-limit flexion; successive resection; contributions in % of resisting moment.
how_to_simulate: Flex the motion segment to the full (or half) flexion angle
Remove structures successively and compute the % of resisting moment carried by disc and by the posterior ligaments
protocol.notes: Secondary data compiled in a review (Ghezelbash et al.'s review). Sample size, specimen age, rate and cycles are not given in the review; use the primary paper for these. Primary source: Adams M, Hutton W, Stott J 1980 (The resistance to flexion of the lumbar intervertebral joint).

extraction.from: Table 1 (load-sharing contributions, in vitro and FE)
extraction.check_notes: Re-read against the rendered Table 1 image (page 4, 200 dpi); footnote symbols checked (dagger = disc sectioned, # = posterior elements dissected, double dagger = sum of capsular, flavum and supra/interspinous ligaments, || = capsular ligaments). | 2026-11-12: source.n was the primary paper year (1980); primary n not available here, set to null.
